services.title: Book formatting & typesetting
services.text: Professional interior layout for paperback, hardcover and ebook, built to the requirements of Amazon KDP, IngramSpark and other platforms.

services.title: Proofreading
services.text: A careful final check of your manuscript for spelling, grammar, punctuation, typos and small consistency issues before publication.

services.title: Copy editing
services.text: Clearer, smoother sentences. I improve structure, clarity, readability, grammar and consistency while keeping your voice and your meaning.

services.title: Book cover design
services.text: Covers that look at home next to bestsellers in your genre, designed to stand out as a tiny thumbnail and on the shelf.
points: Full print wrap: front, spine & back

services.title: Book translation
services.text: Reach English-speaking readers. I translate your book from its original language into polished English, in the variety your readers use, and rebuild the layout so the new edition is ready to publish.
points: Into American, British or Canadian English

services.title: Developmental editing
services.text: A big-picture look at plot, pacing, structure, character development and overall flow. Available as an add-on or on its own, for projects within my areas of expertise.
